Entries.spring_27_1: There's an elegant Gotoran woman in town.#$b#Her and her son seem like they've been in the Ferngill Republic for some time.$3
Entries.spring_27_2: Olivia and I spoke the other night.#$b#I'm going to try and help her send some letters.$1
Entries.summer_27_1: I don't fully understand that farmer Andy.$s
Entries.summer_27_2: Andy doesn't like when I patrol too close to his farm.$s#$b#I can respect that.
Entries.winter_27_2: There are many graves throughout the deepest parts of the forest.$s#$b#There was a war here, once.$5#$b#Between who, I wonder?$s
Entries.eventseen_4000004_memory_oneday: The other day, my radio signal picked up a Haruhi Kiyoko recording.$s#$b#I wonder who could have been playing her?$s#$b#It brought tears to my eyes.
Entries.eventseen_8982806_memory_oneday: Ah, you survived the party!$h#$b#I helped some townsfolk get home last night.
Entries.eventseen_2120303_memory_oneday: The bear that lives deep in the woods...$s#$b#I swear I saw him at Marnie's yesterday.$s
